clips.title: The story
paras: The Hall of Arms is the martial wing of Northshire Abbey, situated south of the Main Hall. Here, veteran instructors drill the newest recruits of the Stormwind Army in the arts of the sword, shield, and holy combat.

While the clerics and scholars ponder ancient tomes across the courtyard in the Library Wing, the Hall of Arms rings with the clash of blunted steel and the heavy cadence of martial instruction. Positioned on the south side of Northshire Abbey, this chamber serves as the primary training station for raw human fighters and devout aspirants taking up arms for the Stormwind Army. Here, seasoned battle instructors and paladin mentors teach the basic postures, disciplines, and fundamentals required to defend Elwynn Forest against encroaching kobolds, Defias bandits, and orc raiders.
